item.title: [News] After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
item.description: US midterm results have led to widespread rejection of data center ballot measures, creating regulatory hurdles for hyperscalers and affecting future data center expansion plans. This policy shift could alter the availability of on‑prem and cloud infrastructure for enterprises relying on large-scale compute resources.

item.title: [News] GitHub New pull request overview page in public preview
item.description: GitHub has launched a new pull request overview page in public preview, placing merge status and actionable next steps at the top of the page to reduce scrolling and improve review efficiency. The feature also introduces compact views of checks, comments, and approvals, along with filters to focus on unresolved discussions and recent activity.

item.title: [News] Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
item.description: Physicl has secured $10M to develop a high-fidelity simulation platform, Studio, aimed at generating synthetic data for training robots in complex physical tasks. The new tool offers 10,000 3D environments and 100,000 assets, positioning Physicl as a contender in the emerging foundation model data marketplace.

item.title: [News] Making any integer with four 2s (2025)
item.description: A Hacker News post discusses a math puzzle that uses exactly four 2s to represent any integer using various mathematical operations, including exponents, factorials, and complex numbers.
